scope: All capabilities run on this machine; no remote machine is required. Add nodes and deploy services later in Terminal.
installDescription: Install Terminal, Manager, Agent, all local business services, workers and default configuration. Management services start after installation; market data, trading and research still require their data sources, accounts and authorization.
upgradeDescription: Upgrade this machine and every installed remote node, preserving configuration and business data. Handle trading, finish tasks and stop business services first. Offline nodes block the upgrade.
uninstallDescription: Remove the local application and service registrations. Configuration and business data are kept by default; clear the option below to delete them as well.
stopInstructions: Finish tasks, handle trading safely and stop local business services in Terminal, then close Terminal. Stop Agent and Manager here afterwards. The installer never force-stops business work.
conflict: Installation needs attention. Review the reason below.
noPackage: No complete installation source is available. Run the installer containing Terminal.
preserveBody: Node identity, configuration, market data, tasks, trading records and secure storage are retained. Uninstalling does not cancel orders or close positions.
starting: Start Agent and Manager and wait for readiness
failureHelp: Review the reason below, correct it and check again. Failure never automatically deletes user data or starts trading.
success: Operation completed. User data was retained.
confirm: I confirm the operation scope and understand that user data is retained.
pending: An operation is unfinished. Select it to continue
installModeDescription: Install the complete local system for the current user. No remote node is required; installation never logs into a broker or starts trading.
upgradeModeDescription: An earlier version is installed. Update the programs and retain user data.
maintenanceModeDescription: Terminal is installed. Repair the programs or remove the installation.
resumeModeDescription: An operation is unfinished. Resolve its failure and continue with the same package version.
repairDescription: Redeploy the complete application from the same version package and restore service registrations. Retain configuration, identity and business data; configuration is not reset and business data is not repaired.
olderPackage: The installed version is newer than this package. Downgrade and repair with this package are unavailable. Use the matching package to repair; uninstall remains available.
deleteTitle: Local configuration and business data will be permanently deleted
deleteBody: Uninstall will delete local configuration, node identity and connection keys, account settings, market data, tasks, trading records and connection registrations in the directories below. This cannot be undone; uninstalling does not cancel orders or close positions.
deleteExclusions: Diagnostic logs are retained. OS keyring credentials, external exports and data on remote machines are unaffected.
confirmDelete: I confirm permanent deletion of the local configuration and business data above and understand that this cannot be undone.
successRemovedData: Uninstall completed. The selected local configuration and business data were deleted.
failureDeleteHelp: Review the reason below, correct it and check again. If data deletion was selected, some content may already have been removed before failure; continuing does not restore deleted data.
remoteDescription: Maintain nodes already registered in Terminal. Upgrades include all installed remote nodes; stop business services first. Unreachable nodes block maintenance. Local-only removal leaves remote services running.
remoteContinueHelp: Resume preparation through local upgrade/repair. After all programs are prepared and this machine is updated, finish remote startup.
remoteDeleteWarning: Permanently delete configuration, identities and business data in the selected remote node directories. Keep diagnostic logs, other nodes and shared host configuration.
remoteConfirm: I confirm the remote scope, have handled trading and stopped business services, and understand selected data deletion is irreversible.
remotePrivateKey: Existing node SSH private key (optional, this installer session only; leave empty to use the managed key)
remoteAll: Also uninstall all remote nodes (remote first, then local; data retention applies to every node)
remotePreserveOption: Preserve configuration and business data on selected remote nodes
